description: N-S sub-DTM (stereo strip) seams of NAC_DTM_APOLLO16 near the Apollo 16 LM / chosen core, traced from the DTM (rows 3950-6949 = +-3 km around the LM latitude). Used by dtm_extract.py --deseam.
convention: For DTM pixel row r = row_first + k: the seam lies between pixel columns cols[k]-1 and cols[k] (GDAL corner coordinate cols[k]); steps[k] = z(east) - z(west) jump beyond the local trend [m] (51-row running median). Correction: z -= sign(d) * step/2 * 0.5*(1+cos(pi*|d|/L)) for |d| < L, d = signed east distance of the pixel centre from the seam [m]; faded out beyond the traced rows.
